newsitem.title: USA: OHM Corp may divest 40 pct NSC stake.
newsitem.headline: OHM Corp may divest 40 pct NSC stake.

text.p: OHM Corp, an environmental services firm, on Wednesday said it was considering the sale of its 40 percent interest in NSC Corp, which would result in about a $12 million after-tax charge.
The company also said it was writing down some receivables after reaching a settlement in principle of litigation concerning work the company undertook in 1993 in the Lake Charles, Louisiana, area.

The settlement and write-down could result in about a $20 million after-tax charge in the second quarter, $18.5 million of which is non-cash. The moves will also generate about $12 million in cash and significantly reduce legal and administrative expenses, the company said.
The settlement in principle is with Citgo Petroleum Corp, Oxy USA Inc and Occidental Oil and Gas Corp, the company said.
OHM shares closed up 1/8 at 8-3/8 Wednesday.
Shares of NSC, which provides asbestos abatement and restoration services, rose 5/8 to 2-3/8.
